name: DragonSwordWorldRadar
renderer: WinForms source compiled in memory by Windows PowerShell 5.1
automatic_start: resident hidden WScript watcher started and validated by Install.cmd and registered in the current user Startup folder; game-time Lua writes only a launch request; the hidden PowerShell host and Overlay bind to and exit with the exact game process
data_installation: local game PAK extraction through in-memory C# and the ooz.exe decoder
game_update_detection: stored executable/PAK fingerprint checked on each game launch
boss_runtime_tracking: tb_actor_respawn read from consistent .db/.bak plus WAL/SHM/journal snapshots; no Character enumeration
boss_marker: single enlarged vector marker modeled on Icon_Mark_FieldBoss_Sprite and shared by all bosses
pawn_tracking: Current PlayerController.Pawn sampled directly; no Lua-wrapper identity comparison

logging.normal_mode: startup, shutdown, actionable errors, and key state changes only; expected pre-login save-key readiness and periodic performance counters are Debug-only
logging.debug_mode: producer queue/update latency, 50/100/250 ms stalls, sampling/write rates, Overlay timer/paint gaps, normalized process CPU, working set, overlay geometry, and MAP_SURFACE_PREPARED hidden-prepaint timing
logging.fps_metric: overlayPaintFps is the WinForms paint rate and is not the game Present FPS

bridge_protocol: alternating static JSON plus compact sequence-validated fixed 21-field motion slots
treasure_marker_outline: DrawEllipse and reusable GraphicsPath outlines use the shared neutral dark RadarMarkerStyle.Outline
background_visibility: overlay hides when the game is minimized or not foreground, restores without activation, and remains hidden while disabled
runtime_probe_hooks: none; exploration probes are isolated in DragonSwordWorldDataProbe
installer_overlay_validation: Install.ps1 compiles the exact complete overlay source set under Windows PowerShell 5.1; installation stops on compile failure
config_validation: malformed preserved config.lua is archived and replaced by a validated complete default

marker_style.nearest_marker: larger diameter; no purple selection ring
marker_style.anti_aliasing: disabled only for treasure geometry to avoid transparency-key fringe

refactor.motion_parser: reusable per-slot candidate buffers/models with direct 21-field ASCII parsing and isolated reusable published MotionFrame/WorldMapState instances
refactor.world_rendering: single projection pass with reusable winding paths, pixel dedupe, projected-marker storage, and transactional double-buffered per-map visibility indexes
refactor.save_state_publication: immutable copy-on-write treasure, boss, alias, and ignore snapshots; consistent opened-state capture; native SQLCipher callback exception containment; load-token invalidation
refactor.render_resources: retained boss and height-indicator GDI resources plus one shared neutral treasure-outline pen
refactor.boss_availability: maintenance-cached next-availability deadlines with deadline-transition invalidation

reliability.compile_gate: Build-Release.ps1, Compile-Source.ps1, and Install.ps1 require Windows PowerShell 5.1 Add-Type compilation; Install.cmd must print OVERLAY_COMPILE_OK
reliability.module_fault_isolation: save state, catalog, visibility index, boss availability, diagnostics, timer, renderer, and game-thread callback failures are isolated and rate-limited
reliability.catalog_publication: catalog and override replacements publish only after before/after file stamp consistency checks
reliability.visibility_index_publication: replacement per-map index is built in staging and swapped only after a complete successful rebuild
reliability.native_callback_boundary: managed SQLCipher row callback exceptions are captured before returning through sqlite3
reliability.adaptive_scheduler: active/idle timer transitions are driven only by published visual changes; no protocol fields were added
reliability.codedom_scope_compatibility: local variables use unique names across nested method scopes for Windows PowerShell 5.1 CodeDOM
reliability.mods_txt_switch: installer preserves an existing DragonSwordWorldRadar 0/1 value; Lua and Overlay stop when the value becomes 0
reliability.world_map_state_machine: entry is detected by the 250 ms static update; while active, map motion is sampled at 24 ms; the first missing active-map read exits immediately with no stale re-entry hysteresis
reliability.world_map_window_lifecycle: the form is hidden before radar/world geometry changes; SetWindowPos discards old client bits, the newly sized hidden surface is repainted synchronously, and it shows without activation in the same timer cycle; a successful hidden prepaint suppresses the redundant post-show invalidate; no timed reveal delay remains
reliability.async_pending_recovery: all Lua game-thread queue and callback failures clear their pending gates so the next loop can recover
reliability.boss_respawn_schedule: fixed RespawnCycle rule 106: daily 09:00 local reset; no runtime PAK discovery
reliability.debug_config_load: read once at Overlay process startup; changing mode requires process restart
reliability.overlay_launch: Install.cmd validates a resident console-free WScript watcher; game-time Lua writes a digits-only runtime/launch.request and never invokes cmd.exe, wscript.exe, or powershell.exe
reliability.save_key_startup: expected owner/key-not-ready states before the first successful save load are Debug-only; later failures remain actionable Use-log errors

performance.motion_sampling: 24 ms in minimap and active world-map modes; compact records are written only after a visual delta or a 1000 ms heartbeat
performance.bridge_reads: FileInfo stamp gates prevent opening unchanged motion and static slots
performance.redraw_policy: heartbeat-only motion frames and visually equivalent static states do not invalidate the form
performance.render_batching: non-nearest minimap and world-map treasure markers are grouped into four retained GraphicsPath batches with one smoothing-state scope
performance.process_tracking: overlay geometry, lifetime checks, and save polling reuse a validated tracked PID before enumerating processes
performance.radar_geometry: actual small top-right layered window; no transparent full-client radar surface
performance.world_map_geometry: actual game-client-sized layered window only while the world map is active
performance.world_map_probe_policy: the 24 ms radar motion loop does not read world-map UObjects; active map state is reused by the static publisher instead of read twice
performance.debug_mode_policy: startup-only configuration; restart Overlay process to change mode
performance.boss_respawn_schedule: immutable fixed daily 09:00 local reset; no filesystem scan or parser
performance.debug_config_policy: startup-only configuration; no Timer-driven file polling
performance.world_map_transition: hide, SWP_NOCOPYBITS resize, synchronous hidden-surface repaint, and SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE occur without a fixed delay and only when geometry changes; paint-sequence confirmation prevents a second full-screen invalidate when prepaint succeeded
performance.save_key_discovery: cached/current/legacy RVAs are attempted before a delayed one-time worker-thread full-executable signature fallback; transient owner/key-not-ready states do not trigger an early scan and do not disable the fallback
performance.launcher_policy: resident WScript watcher validates a digits-only request stamp and performs no game-time shell creation from Lua; the PowerShell host is hidden and game-bound
